system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The account was created at 13:46:38 UTC, later than the alert's approximate 13:42 time. Lucy Park was the recorded creator.
The account name follows the stated temporary-account convention, and it was added to Temp-Staff.
Lucy Park had an interactive RDP session to FILE-HD-01 beginning at 13:21:54 UTC from WS-LPARK-01; the workstation's RDP connection to the server is also recorded.

The RDP session is inconsistent with the stated practice that remote administration is done only from WS-OHADDAD-01. This is a concern, but the records do not establish why Lucy connected or whether the connection was malicious.

A UserAssist registry value written during the review window contains a ROT13-encoded path that decodes to PowerShell. This suggests PowerShell may have been launched, but the evidence does not show its command line or actions.
The domain controller records a network logon for Lucy followed by the account creation under the same logon ID, supporting that Lucy's credentials were used for the creation.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records do not include a ticket or other authorization for creating tmp.rwong or for Lucy's RDP session.
The supplied session records show initial userinit and explorer activity on FILE-HD-01 but do not establish what Lucy did during the rest of the RDP session.
The PowerShell-related UserAssist entry does not provide a process command line, script content, or proof of what was executed.
The account records show membership in Temp-Staff but do not provide a complete view of all group memberships or subsequent account use.
claims_not_established: Whether the temporary account was requested for legitimate work and approved.
Whether Lucy's RDP access to FILE-HD-01 was authorized or related to the account creation.
Whether PowerShell actually executed and, if so, what commands or scripts it ran.
Whether tmp.rwong received additional privileges, was used to access resources, or was later disabled or deleted.
Whether the Cloudflare browsing was ordinary web use or related to other activity not represented in these records.
additional_evidence_needed: Help-desk tickets, approvals, or other records explaining the creation of tmp.rwong and the RDP session.
FILE-HD-01 process, PowerShell, file-access, and session activity logs for Lucy's RDP logon.
PowerShell operational/script-block logs and process-creation telemetry from WS-LPARK-01 around 14:07 UTC.
The new account's complete group memberships, directory changes, logons, and lifecycle events after creation.
Relevant proxy and endpoint telemetry for Lucy's workstation during the review window.
